comments.value: I was able to trigger this at step 7 in my Unity 2022.3.22f1 project.
I've encountered this just by adding the UdonBehavior Array in the Variables of the UdonGraph. It fails to compile and throws the same Assembly error. It does not look to be fixed since this post.

details:
Getting lots of these errors in the unity console. Here are some simple steps to reproduce the errors.
1. Create new unity project in 2019.4.31f1
2. import latest VRC SDK for worlds (VRCSDK3-WORLD-2021.11.24.16.19_Public)
3. open Udon Example Scene
4. select any object in the hierarchy
5. create a new udon behavior component
6. open the udon graph
7. add a variable for an UdonBehavior[]
8. add a reference to the new variable in the graph
9. add the array get graph node
